game_title: Door Defense – Moss Door Chamber Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber, a mossy sealed door: the shadow ranger must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Door Defense: Push to repair the supply cache while the while-loop condition stays true and skeleton miners keep attacking.
theme: Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber: a mossy sealed door
core_gameplay_loop: In Moss Door Chamber, repeat each round: Push to repair the supply cache while the while-loop condition stays true and skeleton miners keep attacking. Each round, skeleton miners strike the supply cache, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the door_health value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the supply cache from skeleton miners in Moss Door Chamber: keep the door_health meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 51-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: door_health drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 51-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Door Defense
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how door_health changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against skeleton miners in Moss Door Chamber.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 51 seconds while door_health > 0.
